settings.question: What is Obagi Subscribe & Save?
settings.answer: Obagi.com offers a Subscribe & Save subscription service on select Obagi® products. This allows you to receive your favorite products on a recurring basis and save money while you do it! Subscribe & Save offers discounts of up to 15% on your initial and recurring orders, and exclusive gifts. You can choose how often you want to receive your products, and there's no commitment, so you can cancel at any time. To sign up for Subscribe & Save, simply select the Subscribe purchase option on the eligible product page, choose your preferred quantity and frequency, and add the eligible item to your cart. Once you place your order, you'll receive an email confirmation and reminders before each shipment, so you can make any changes you need. And if you ever need to cancel, you can do so with just a few clicks. Subscribe & Save is a great way to save money and time on your favorite Obagi® products. Subscribe & Save discounts and any limited time subscription promotions apply only to eligible items indicated on Obagi.com, and then only if you select the Subscribe & Save purchase option method. Eligible products are subject to change based on Obagi's discretion. Click HERE to visit our Subscribe & Save Policy page.

settings.question: How do I sign up for Obagi Subscribe & Save?
settings.answer: Signing up is easy. Look for the product you love and select the Subscribe purchase option. Choose the quantity and monthly frequency of your subscription (1/2/3/4 months) and add the product to your cart. Click here to start saving today.

settings.question: What happens after I sign up for the service?
settings.answer: After you place your first Obagi Subscribe & Save order, you will receive emails regarding your Obagi subscription order(s). If you don’t see these emails, please check your spam folder. Periodically, you will receive email communications on your subscription status related to upcoming orders, payment methods, out of stock, discontinued/replacement products, order reminders, order confirmation, credit card expiration warning, and other transaction related emails. To manage your subscription account, create an account click here to access your subscriptions today.

settings.question: How often should I expect my subscription to come?
settings.answer: Your Subscribe & Save subscription will automatically create a new order according to your chosen delivery schedule until you cancel it. 4 days before your recurring order is placed, you will receive an email reminder of your upcoming recurring order. This email will include a link to your subscription portal. There, you can view your subscription order details, such as how often you will receive your orders. Click here to create an account or log into your subscription portal.

settings.question: How do I manage my subscription orders?
settings.answer: You can manage your subscription orders when you receive a subscription email notification, or by visiting My Account page – Subscriptions section. You will be required to create an Obagi account to access My Account, or for personal assistance call toll-free at 1-800-636-7546, Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. CST. You can also contact us by email: customerservice@obagi.com.

settings.question: How do I view my future deliveries?
settings.answer: You can view your future orders by logging into your Obagi Account and visiting ‘My Subscriptions’ area within the My Account section.

settings.question: How will I know about upcoming subscription orders?
settings.answer: 4 days before your recurring order is placed, you will receive an email reminder of your upcoming recurring order. This email will include a link to your subscription portal. There, you can view your subscription order details, such as how often you will receive your orders. You can also manage your subscription order by visiting Obagi.com and signing into your My Account page.

settings.question: Why would Obagi cancel my subscription?
settings.answer: Obagi reserves the right to cancel a member’s subscription at any time, due to an item being out of stock, or if a product has been discontinued. Any fraudulent activity will warrant account suspension and cancellation of ALL subscription services. You can manage your subscriptions by visiting the My Accounts page on Obagi.com.

settings.question: Why would I not receive my subscription?
settings.answer: It is possible that your subscription may get delayed, paused, or canceled if products are out of stock, discontinued, or no longer available, products are no longer eligible for subscription, transportation services are delayed, a credit card is not valid, fraud, or for any other reason. You can manage your subscriptions by visiting the My Accounts page on Obagi.com.

settings.question: Why is my product getting swapped in my subscription?
settings.answer: When a product is discontinued, a similar product will be swapped so that you don’t miss a beat with your routine. You will receive an email notification of the discontinuation and the product recommendation. You can choose to cancel your subscription if you’re not satisfied with the suggested product replacement. You can manage your subscriptions by visiting the My Accounts page on Obagi.com.

settings.question: How do I update my Payment information for my account?
settings.answer: If you need to update your credit card information, you will first need to create an Obagi account. Once an Obagi account has been created, you can then visit My Accounts page and click on the Subscriptions section. At the bottom of the Subscription section, there is a link to request an email to change your payment information. Obagi will NEVER ask for your credit card information or password. If anyone contacts you requesting personal identification information and you suspect fraud, please notify us right away at 1-800-636-7546.

settings.question: When can I cancel my subscription?
settings.answer: You can pause or cancel your subscription at any time. You can visit the My Accounts page to manage your subscriptions.

settings.question: Why should I Subscribe & Save?
settings.answer: Receive 15% Off every order, surprise gifts, and earn Premier Points with no commitment. Obagi reserves the right to change the Subscribe & Save benefits, including the discount amounts and eligibility used to determine discount amounts, at any time in its sole discretion. All changes will apply to future orders, including for current subscriptions. Click here to view our Subscribe & Save Policy page.
